parameters.name: DynamicGroupExpression
parameters.description: The dynamic group rule, which is used to query and dynamically match devices to the group. For more information about how to write rule expressions, see [SQL-like syntax](~~185713~~).

parameters.name: GroupDesc
parameters.description: The description of the group. The description can be up to 100 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as one character.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the group. The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
